title: The 240 s admission budget still clips post-Begin steps (delivery fence, source observation) after a Begin was applied
outcome: Once a head's Begin has been applied (active_grant_id set), the admission budget no longer clips the steps after the Begin, such as the post-Begin delivery durability fence and the source-observation steps using target.dispatch_deadline. A turn whose Begin succeeded near the deadline is not thrown away to the AdmissionFence abort path and an exhausted hold. A regression test covers a Begin applied just before the budget deadline.
acceptance: The 240 s admission budget still clips post-Begin steps (delivery fence, source observation) after a Begin was applied is done
disposal_reason: Fixed inside w-cfcf10b68c9b's package and lands with it. The round-4 Claude reviewer (delegation-0041847d-55c1-4d7a-8b8e-22941511480b) raised this to a Medium, with a scenario where an applied begin gets stuck in source observation. engram_admission_budget_enforced now exempts an active grant as well as an uncertain one, so post-Begin steps keep only their per-attempt bounds.
